definitions.explanation: The body of law governing private relations between individuals, including property, contracts, family, and inheritance. In Japan, refers specifically to the Civil Code (民法典).

examples.japanese: {民法|みんぽう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
⟦{相続|そうぞく}→相続：03690_souzoku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{関|かん}する→関する：02045_kansuru⟧⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{民法|みんぽう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{定|さだ}められている→定める：10448_sadameru⟧。
examples.english: Provisions regarding inheritance are set out in the civil code.

examples.japanese: ⟦{婚姻|こんいん}→婚姻：12244_konin⟧⟦{年齢|ねんれい}→年齢：01490_nenrei⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{引|ひ}き{下|さ}げ→引き下げ：12553_hikisage⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{含|ふく}む→含む：01982_fukumu⟧{民法|みんぽう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{大幅|おおはば}→大幅：12170_oohaba⟧な⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{国会|こっかい}→国会：02761_kokkai⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{審議|しんぎ}→審議：19112_shingi⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: A major revision of the civil code, including lowering the marriage age, is being deliberated in the Diet.

notes:
USAGE:
A legal term used in academic, legal, and news contexts. Japan's {民法|みんぽう} was originally modeled on European civil law systems and has been revised multiple times, most recently regarding the age of majority and marriage.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {民法|みんぽう}⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧: civil code revision
- {民法|みんぽう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{規定|きてい}→規定：14136_kitei⟧: provisions of the civil code
- {民法|みんぽう}⟦{上|じょう}→〜上：30365_jou⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧: under civil law
- {民法|みんぽう}{学者|がくしゃ}: civil law scholar
